verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Dynadot publishes an llms.txt at https://www.dynadot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the registrar, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Dynadot also documents an official MCP page aimed at AI-assistant use. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's full contents and depth (only its opening lines were captured), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.dynadot.com/llms.txt # Dynadot
Dynadot MCP is an easier way to manage your domains, just by talking to an AI assistant.
